dramatic_structure.goal: make one required object handoff govern the next procedure
objectives: transfer and install the calibrated sensor
dramatic_structure.obstacle: the next step cannot begin before custody is confirmed
dramatic_structure.stakes: the calibration record would be invalid if the wrong unit enters the cradle

locked_facts.value: One project-original blue sensor is the only calibrated unit in the room.
Technician A transfers the calibrated sensor across a marked handoff line to Technician B.
Technician B may place the sensor in the test cradle only after the new custody state is visible.
